definition: One clamped-nuclei static electronic dipole polarizability tensor in atomic units per input geometry, nine unsymmetrized Cartesian readouts and three independent RHS.
population: All entries, in order, from the frozen CC0 first-1000 QM9 manifest. Constructed dense property mask, one request per geometry.
conditioning: Record the independent HOMO-LUMO gap and flag gaps below 0.001 Hartree. This is a gap indicator only.
failure_policy: Retain every attempt, including missing or failed native calls. Only failed or rejected requests may use the fixed tighter solver settings. Publish a label only if an independent scorer subsequently accepts it.
performance_scope: Measure absolute production, reference, verification, serialization and storage costs. No multi-arm timing or throughput speedup claim in this label campaign.
